contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS-REI P[VBLICAE] ; D/ [D N VAL]ENTINI-ANVS P [F AVG]

An incomplete nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS-REI P[VBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm. Mint is Lyon, AD 364-375. Obverse legend reads [D N VAL]ENTINI-ANVS P [F AVG]. Obverse shows a diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: OF/III/[...].
